description: A clear UI feature request (formerly the UX case; browser testing is out of scope, so it is graded as a plain feature request) gets a spec that keeps the persistence requirement.

issue.title: Add dark mode toggle
issue.body: Add a dark mode toggle button in the top-right corner of the page. When clicked, it should switch the page to a dark color scheme (dark background, light text). The preference should persist across page reloads using localStorage. The toggle should show a sun icon in dark mode and a moon icon in light mode.
